_comment: The optional apps, for the setup portal and the settings page's Apps page.
Installed to /usr/share/biscuit/apps.json. One file for both, so the two
cannot describe the same app differently. Sizes are installed sizes with
dependencies, measured with `apk del --simulate` on r287; the Apps page
measures them live, this is for the setup portal, which is offline.
`changes` lists every file in this repository that alters the upstream
code, so the Apps page can link each one.

`functions` says which services make up each thing the device does, for the Processes page; what those services need, which processes they run and which packages own them are all read from the device.

core.label: Device software
core.summary: Everything that makes this Echo work: Wi-Fi and its setup hotspot, Bluetooth speaker, casting and calls, the speaker and microphones, the light ring and buttons, timekeeping, and this settings page.
core.firmware: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and microphone firmware is this Echo's own, taken from its backup when postmarketOS was installed. None is downloaded.
core.name: device-amazon-biscuit

apps.label: Voice assistant
apps.summary: Wake word and voice control through Home Assistant.
apps.description: Listens for the wake word on this device and passes your request to Home Assistant's Assist. Nothing leaves the device until the wake word is heard.
connects_to: Home Assistant, which connects in and sends back spoken replies

changes.why: Uses the device's own microphone processing instead of adding LVA's on top
Level control for the wake word only
One master volume: the device's, with the players left at full
Quietens a warning that fills the log
Light ring, buttons and settings for Home Assistant
Keeps that interface on a root-only local socket
Our options, and no network-facing control port
Barge-in, ducking and timers on this hardware
Home Assistant entities for the device
Plays to the device's speaker, with its volume curve

apps.name: linux-voice-assistant

apps.label: Music speaker
apps.summary: Play to this device from Music Assistant, alone or grouped with other speakers.
apps.description: Joins Music Assistant as a Sendspin speaker. Music Assistant finds it on the network, and it plays in step with other Sendspin speakers.
connects_to: Music Assistant, found on the network

changes.why: Drives the light ring from the music
Asks Music Assistant for the spectrum and track colours
Accepts the seek commands Music Assistant sends; without it every status message was rejected
Starts the visualiser when the speaker connects out to Music Assistant

apps.name: sendspin
